podcast.body: This album, released in 2004, features the instrumental piece "If I Could Fly," which was later cited in a lawsuit against Coldplay for similarities to their 2008 song "Viva La Vida." "In 2004, Centriani released an album called Is There Love in Space? And on that record is a piece entitled If I Could Fly."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
